# Musica

> Musica is a mobile-first progressive web app that turns a YouTube link, Spotify link, song search or local audio file into a chord sheet with lyrics, key, tempo and instrument diagrams. All music analysis (key, tempo, beats and chords) runs on the phone with Essentia.js in a Web Worker; a small FastAPI service fetches audio with yt-dlp and ffmpeg. No accounts, no AI tokens, no database.

- What it is: a chord detection and play-along app for musicians (guitar chords, key detection, tempo detection, lyrics)
- Stack: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, Essentia.js (WASM), Web Workers; Python FastAPI, yt-dlp, ffmpeg; lyrics from LRCLIB
- Live demo: https://www.musicaa.site
- Hosting: web on Vercel, audio service in a container (Railway or similar)
